HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)

   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
